youtube.title: Why Is The Sky Blue? 🌤️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Sunlight contains all colours. Molecules in the air scatter shorter wavelengths far more strongly (Rayleigh scattering), so blue light is scattered across the whole sky. At sunrise and sunset, light passes through much more air, the blue is scattered away, and reds and oranges remain.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
